name: rcases
content: `rcases` is a tactic that will perform `cases` recursively, according to a pattern. One use is to provide explicit names for variables in each subgoal. For example, given a hypothesis `h : P ∨ Q`, `rcases h with p | q` can be used in place of `cases h` to give hypotheses `p : P` in the first case and `q : Q`.
